paragraphs: Teacher Kim has a big white poster. It says, "All About Me." We make a poster about us. My name is Leo. I am seven years old. How old are you? I write my name in red. I write seven in blue. I have new pens and crayons.

I draw a picture of my mother. She has a big smile. She wears a yellow dress. I draw my father too. He has a funny hat. Then I draw my grandma next to our house. She is old, and she is very funny. She tells me a story at night. Who do you draw?

I draw my teacher at the end. Teacher Kim looks at my picture. "Leo, your teacher has a silly hat!" "It is a nice hat!" I say. Teacher Kim smiles at me. She puts my poster on the wall. It is a good poster. The class likes it. Make a poster about you!
text.summary: Leo makes a class poster called All About Me. He draws his family and his teacher, and he asks the reader some questions.
